primary_question: Can a physics-informed, uncertainty-aware layer generate and robustly rank complete PCL electrolyte specifications using the existing PolyGen workspace?
estimand: Group-held-out RMSE of log10 conductivity and the minimum lower-confidence-bound conductivity over 303.15--363.15 K for each candidate formulation.
interpretation_boundary: Validated only for 80 kDa PCL, observed salts, in-range molality and temperature. PolyGen-generated repeat units are interface/OOD tests, not cross-chemistry predictions.
unit_of_observation: one measured conductivity at one salt/molality/temperature condition
pairing_group: salt identity plus molality; all temperatures for a formulation remain in one fold

model.regression: ridge with salt, molality polynomial, VTF and salt-by-molality interactions
model.uncertainty: 40 formulation-group bootstrap fits; 5th percentile is the lower confidence bound

candidate_space.salts: all 17 observed salts with at least two distinct molalities

selection: maximize the minimum 5th-percentile predicted log10 conductivity across the temperature window
